input.quote: (a) In the event the Company terminates this Agreement, the Company shall pay to HDI a termination payment, (the "Termination Payment") the amount of which shall be an amount equal to the aggregate Net Sales for the twelve (12) months preceding the Termination Date less $800,000, the balance of which shall be divided by two.
input.rationale: Section 4.2 obliges us (the Company) to pay HDI a stipulated Termination Payment whenever we terminate, computed as half of trailing twelve-month Net Sales above $800,000 and payable in eight quarterly instalments. That is a liquidated amount payable by Customer with no ceiling and, given fees are only 30% of Net Sales above $11,000 per month, it can far exceed three months' fees, so it fails the fallback. Deleting the payment altogether to reach preferred would require collateral rewrites of 4.2(b), (c) and the Section 4 heading, so we take the fallback: we retain the existing calculation verbatim (preserving the Customer-favourable $800,000 deduction and 50% halving, which keep 4.2(b)'s zero/negative test operable) and add only a proviso capping the amount at three months' Section 3.1 fees, together with a short new 4.2(d) confirming it is the only early-termination fee and sole liquidated amount we owe.

proposal.summary: Keep the existing Termination Payment calculation but cap it at three months' Section 3.1 fees and confirm it is the sole liquidated amount payable by the Company.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We retained the existing calculation (including the $800,000 deduction and halving) and added only a proviso capping the Termination Payment at three months' Section 3.1 fees, plus a new Section 4.2(d) confirming it is the only early-termination fee and sole liquidated amount we owe.

ops.newText: (a) In the event the Company terminates this Agreement, the Company shall pay to HDI a termination payment, (the "Termination Payment") the amount of which shall be an amount equal to the aggregate Net Sales for the twelve (12) months preceding the Termination Date less $800,000, the balance of which shall be divided by two, provided that the Termination Payment shall not exceed the fees payable to HDI under Section 3.1 for the three (3) months preceding the Termination Date.

ops.text: The Termination Payment is the only early-termination fee and the sole liquidated amount payable by the Company.

mappings.element: Any Customer-payable liquidated amount is only an early-termination fee.
The early-termination fee is capped at three months of fees.
The early-termination fee is the sole liquidated amount payable by Customer.
